about: Originally developed by Digital Pictures in 1987 and released in 1992, Night Trap has been completely rebuilt for the PLAYSTATION®5, bringing it to 4K!
Night Trap tells the story of five teenage girls spending the weekend at the Martin home.
As a member of the Special Control Attack Team, your job is to monitor the home and protect the girls using an intricate system of cameras and traps as it is being invaded by vampires.

Night Trap also includes new features such as deleted scenes, documentaries, a theater that allows you to watch all story-related videos uninterrupted, new game modes, and behind the scenes production images and documents.
summary: You'll get caught in the night...
